play_signal: Converts each mission's art kit, region, district style, landmark, visual profile, and terrain token into reviewable in-world regional-kit anchors
Entry-side kit bible gate names the active art kit, region, and terrain family before the player reaches the main route
Landmark vista kit makes the city's landmark and signature cue visible as a navigation silhouette instead of only a data row
Objective district kit surfaces district style, profile district cues, modular swatches, and route-facing signal light near the playable objective path
Art-kit motif chooses harbor, desert solar, mountain, industrial, civic, transit, or metro module language from mission data
